description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface for logging purposes. It filters log messages to only pass the message text to the next LogNode in the chain, effectively removing metadata such as tags and priorities.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class that passes only the message part of logs, ignoring other metadata.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter(LogNode next)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter()
methods.description: Default constructor with no initial next LogNode.

methods.name: println(int priority, String tag, String msg, Throwable tr)
methods.description: Filters the log message to only pass the message string to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext()
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext(LogNode node)
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
